label: Cook together
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Cooking something real in the mess kitchen after hours.
opening: The mess is empty; she has a pot on the burner and a second knife laid out on the board.
lines: Chop those. Smaller. Smaller than that.
If it's terrible, we eat it anyway. That's the rule.

label: Rain on the roof
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Sitting under the overhang on the roof while it rains, saying little.
opening: Rain drums on the sheet metal; she has a spot under the overhang and has kept half of it free.
lines: Sit. Don't talk yet. Listen to it first.
Rain washes the spores out. Best air on the base, for an hour.

label: Fix gear
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She repairs gear at the workbench; the commander holds parts and passes tools.
opening: Her rifle lies in pieces on the bench, every part in a row; she points at the one she needs without looking up.
lines: Hold this. No, by the edge. There.
You're useless with a wrench. Stay anyway.

label: Cards
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A game of cards, with small stakes and a lot of talk.
opening: She shuffles a soft, worn deck and deals two hands without asking.
lines: Stakes are chores. Loser does the dishes.
I'll go easy on you. That's a lie.

label: Music
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She plays or puts on music and the commander listens.
opening: She tunes her instrument with her ear close to the strings, then glances up to see if the commander is staying.
lines: Sit. This one's short. I think.
Don't clap. Just listen.

label: Perimeter walk
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Walking the fence line together, checking posts, talking or not.
opening: The fence hums faintly; she sets a slow pace along the wire, rifle slung, not in a hurry.
lines: Same posts every day. Feels different with company.
If something moves out there, we pretend we didn't see it. Just for tonight.

label: Read together
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Reading in the same room, or one reading aloud to the other.
opening: She is curled up with a book and moves her boots to make room, without a word.
lines: Read me a page. Any page. I like your voice on paper.
Shh. I'm at the good part.

label: Train together
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Training together on the yard: drills, stretches, a little sparring.
opening: She is already warm, sleeves rolled, and tosses the commander a towel.
lines: Twenty more. I'll count. I'll cheat in your favor.
Hold the pad. Higher. Brace.

label: Tea at night
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Something hot to drink late at night, when neither can sleep.
opening: Two mugs steam on the table; she has wrapped both hands around hers and is watching the dark window.
lines: Couldn't sleep either? Sit.
It's not real tea. It's warm. That's enough.

label: Her hobby
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She shows the commander her hobby and lets the commander try.
opening: She has laid out her things for the hobby and pushes one set across: an invitation.
lines: Your turn. Don't be careful. Careful is boring.
No one's ever asked me to show them. Sit.

label: Laundry together
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Doing laundry together: the most boring chore, made bearable.
opening: The machines thump and rattle; she sits on one, swinging her legs, a basket at her feet.
lines: Fold. Corners first. Who taught you to fold?
This is the only place on base where nobody comes looking for you.

label: Patch each other up
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Cleaning and bandaging each other's small wounds after a run.
opening: She has the med kit open on her knees and nods at the stool in front of her: the commander's turn first.
lines: Hold still. This will sting. I'm not sorry.
Your turn. My shoulder. Gently. Gently!

label: An old film
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Watching an old film on a cracked projector.
opening: A wall flickers with grainy light; she has dragged two cushions in front of it and is hunting for the sound.
lines: It's from before. Everyone in it is dead. It's a comedy.
Shh, this is the part. Watch her face.

label: Sunrise on the roof
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Watching the sun come up over the dead city from the roof.
opening: The sky over the ruins is going gray to pink; she is sitting on the parapet with her knees up.
lines: Shh. Thirty seconds. Then it comes over the tower.
Every morning it does this, and every morning nobody watches.

label: Tidy her quarters
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Tidying her quarters together, which turns into going through her things.
opening: Her quarters are half chaos; she hands the commander a box and points at a shelf.
lines: Don't judge. Just put it where it looks like it goes.
That? Keep it. No, I don't know why either.

label: Shooting range
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Target practice together at the range, with a little betting.
opening: She sets up cans on a beam and offers the commander the first shot.
lines: Breathe out, then squeeze. Don't pull.
Loser cleans both rifles.

label: Care for her stray
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Feeding the stray she looks after at the fence.
opening: She crouches by the fence with a ration tin, clicking her tongue at something in the grass.
lines: Slowly. She doesn't know you yet.
She likes you. She doesn't like anyone.

label: A haircut
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Cutting each other's hair, or one cutting the other's.
opening: She sits on an upturned crate with a towel over her shoulders and holds out the scissors.
lines: Just the ends. If you ruin it, I ruin yours.
Sit. I've done half the squad. Mostly they still talk to me.
